caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and two front legs, all painted in a solid red color with visible grain texture. The table's legs are turned and have decorative detailing, while the top edge of the table has a slightly rounded finish. The central focus is a large, colored illustration of the table viewed from the front, enclosed within a rectangular outline. Below this main illustration, three smaller technical line drawings are presented: the leftmost shows the table from the front with labeled measurements, the center shows the table from a top-down view with labeled width and depth, and the rightmost is a side view with labeled height and depth. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color with no additional elements.
title: Writing Table and Desk
